name: Chubby's Cafe (Pleasant Grove, UT) Golden Hand-Battered Chicken Tenders & Fries
brandOrRestaurant: Chubby's Neighborhood Cafe (Pleasant Grove / Vineyard, UT)
whyItWorks: Whole white meat chicken tenders fried golden. Lean, bioavailable protein that digests easily when paired with honey mustard or plain ketchup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Tenders basket with fries and honey mustard for dipping (avoid spicy jalapeño sauces).
watchOuts: Peel off outer breading during sensitive phases
